open_points.subject: ensure_manual_budget
open_points.text: - ensure_manual_budget: [DEPENDENCY_BOUNDARY] MUST open one transaction by beginning a transaction with begin of the store, which returns a PortalTransaction, obtain one stable BudgetRepository as the budgets repository of that transaction, read the manual version through get_manual_budget_version, read its plans through list_budget_plans, and use only the temporary list_project_expenses project read of the transaction with flattened aggregate allocations when computing unresolved allocations; it MUST NOT call a legacy budget method.
open_points.other_text:
# ExpenseRepository
def list_project_expenses(self, project_id: UUID) -> list[ExpenseAggregate]
open_points.question: Must the temporary project-expense read be made on PortalTransaction, which no longer declares it, or through ExpenseRepository?

open_points.subject: get_budget_version
open_points.text: - get_budget_version: [DEPENDENCY_BOUNDARY] MUST open one transaction, read the exact version and its plans only through one budgets repository of the transaction, use only the list_project_expenses of the transaction called with the project_id of the context, with flattened aggregate allocations for the temporary allocation read, close that read transaction by exactly one rollback of that transaction, and use no legacy budget method.
open_points.other_text:
# ExpenseRepository
def list_project_expenses(self, project_id: UUID) -> list[ExpenseAggregate]
open_points.question: Must list_project_expenses be called on PortalTransaction, which does not declare it, or on ExpenseRepository?

open_points.subject: get_budget_version
open_points.text: - get_budget_version: [DEPENDENCY_BOUNDARY] MUST use only BudgetRepository, the budgets repository of that transaction, for budget persistence and ProjectSectionRepository, the project_sections repository of that transaction, for project-section persistence; direct legacy PortalTransaction budget and project-section method calls are forbidden, while the list_project_expenses of the transaction called with project_id remains the only temporary legacy persistence call until ExpenseRepository migration and allocations MUST be flattened from those ExpenseAggregate values.
open_points.other_text:
# ExpenseRepository
def list_project_expenses(self, project_id: UUID) -> list[ExpenseAggregate]
open_points.question: Must list_project_expenses remain a PortalTransaction call, or must the note require the declared ExpenseRepository operation?

open_points.subject: upsert_manual_section_plan
open_points.text: - upsert_manual_section_plan: [DEPENDENCY_BOUNDARY] MUST perform optional manual-version creation, optional PortalSection insertion, SectionPlan upsert, required audits, and final reads through one shared transaction using the repositories of that transaction for budgets, for project sections and for audits, and only the temporary list_project_expenses project read of the transaction with flattened aggregate allocations; it MUST NOT call ensure_manual_budget, validate_project_section, or a legacy budget/project-section method from inside that transaction.

open_points.subject: validate_project_section
open_points.text: - validate_project_section: [DEPENDENCY_BOUNDARY] MUST use only BudgetRepository, the budgets repository of that transaction, for budget persistence and ProjectSectionRepository, the project_sections repository of that transaction, for project-section persistence; direct legacy PortalTransaction budget and project-section method calls are forbidden, while the list_project_expenses of the transaction called with project_id remains the only temporary legacy persistence call until ExpenseRepository migration and allocations MUST be flattened from those ExpenseAggregate values.
open_points.other_text:

open_points.question: Must this note continue to allow list_project_expenses as a PortalTransaction operation, or must it identify the declared ExpenseRepository owner?

open_points.subject: ensure_manual_budget
open_points.text: - ensure_manual_budget: [DEPENDENCY_BOUNDARY] MUST reach its persisted records by calling insert_budget_version of the BudgetRepository that budgets of that transaction returns.
open_points.other_text: - ensure_manual_budget: [RETURN_SHAPE] When a manual version already exists, MUST return the detail the imported build_budget_version_detail builds from that exact repository object, all and only its persisted plans ordered by sort_order then section_id and the unresolved allocation count, close the read transaction by exactly one rollback of that transaction, and append no audit.
open_points.question: Must insert_budget_version be called on every invocation, or only on the branch where no manual version exists?

open_points.subject: upsert_manual_section_plan
open_points.text: - upsert_manual_section_plan: [DEPENDENCY_BOUNDARY] MUST reach its persisted records by calling get_manual_budget_version of the BudgetRepository that budgets of that transaction returns, insert_budget_version of that repository, list_budget_plans of that repository and upsert_section_plan of that repository and get_project_section and insert_project_sections of the ProjectSectionRepository that project_sections of that transaction returns.
open_points.other_text: - upsert_manual_section_plan: [FIELD_ASSIGNMENT] MUST reuse the repository's existing manual BudgetVersion object when present or otherwise build it with the imported build_manual_budget_version; for a supplied section_id it MUST obtain the exact project-scoped PortalSection or raise BudgetValidationError, while a missing section_id MUST build one = models.PortalSection with the imported build_manual_portal_section and insert it; both builders receive the context and the single utc_now instant of the operation as now.
open_points.question: Must insert_budget_version, get_project_section, and insert_project_sections all be called on every invocation, or must the dependency note make them conditional on the mutually exclusive creation and section_id branches?
